reviews.comment:
Fin de semana largo…dos pobres empleados. Una chica con muy buena atención, atendiendo a decenas de personas, sola…respondiendo preguntas, cobrando, entregando comida. Y otro empleado preparando hamburguesas a mas no poder para tratar de abastecer a todos.
Por falta de personal (responsable el dueño de la estación claramente) mas de 30 minutos para pagar.
Y un dato no menor, quien vaya al baño (HOMBRE) afueraaaa, baño químico y a pedir permiso en el baño de mujeres para lavarse las manos. Desastre.
Para cargar combustible, otra media hora…dos empleados para largas filas.

(Translated by Google)
Long weekend…two poor employees. One girl with excellent customer service, serving dozens of people, all by herself…answering questions, taking payments, handing out food. And another employee working tirelessly to make hamburgers, trying to keep everyone happy.
Due to staff shortages (clearly the station owner's fault), it took over 30 minutes to pay.
And a crucial detail: men have to go outside to the restroom, use the portable toilet, and even ask permission to use the women's restroom to wash their hands. A disaster.
And to fill up, another half hour…two employees for long lines.
